title: Client-level collateral segregation report to ICCL
purpose: Each client's collateral held at BSE Clearing only (not NSE Clearing's), segment-wise: cash allocated, cash equivalents, non-cash after haircut, total and margin. Clients with nil balance who traded in the last 12 months are included.
source: ICCL notice 20250502-5 (table item 2) and ICCL Member Inspection master circular para 6.1-6.2: the daily client-level collateral segregation report covers collateral held at BSECL only (not aggregated with another clearing corporation), includes nil-balance clients who traded in the last 12 months, with no late upload or modification after the cut-off. Columns follow the SEBI segregation and monitoring fields NSE Clearing's CC01 carries (cash allocated, cash equivalents re-pledged, non-cash re-pledged, total, margins), with the segment and trade date. Built from the notice's description, not from a published file layout: ICCL has not published this file's column layout. The broker must confirm the field order, names and file name against ICCL's file description (member extranet) before the first upload.
